purpose: The seven readings the sky of the arrival composition has to keep. The capitolato's net for every session after the sky one is «cielo entro 2 livelli», and a net needs something to be tied to: this file is that anchor, and tools/grade/check-sky-zones.mjs is the hand that pulls it.
provenance: Measured by the reviewer's gate at the close of the sky-and-grading session, on the composition the committente ratified on that date: the arrival veil at its approved depth, over the sky sealed by the session before it. The values are that frame read to a tenth of a level; the rounding is at most 0.05 and the tolerance below is 2.
reference: the state WITH THE APPROVED VEIL at the reference pose, not the bare drawing buffer. Bare, the frame is a different picture by design — the permanent corner shading left src/core/post.js when the veil took it over — and it is not what this file measures.

conditions.whyThatUrl: the frozen clock holds the arrival: src/ui/veil.js keeps the veil up instead of letting go after its two seconds, so the one instant the reference was measured at can be photographed as many times as a comparison needs.
conditions.subject: page
conditions.whySubjectIsThePage: the veil is a DOM overlay, not something the renderer draws, so a canvas read back through toDataURL is the frame WITHOUT it. What target.png carries is the page, so the page is what gets photographed.
conditions.whyKept: target.png carries both, so hiding them would be measuring a different picture.
conditions.guard: tools/grade/lib/dressed-frame.mjs — nothing is measured until the frame is proven to carry the world.
conditions.luminance: Rec.709 on the coded 8-bit values: the mean R, G and B of the box first, then 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B of that mean. Coded and not linear because that is the space the capitolato counts levels in and the space target.png is written in.
conditions.renderer: a real GPU through ANGLE/D3D11. A run that lands on SwiftShader is reported and its numbers are not comparable.

whyTheseBoxes: Sky and only sky, at four distances from the centre of the frame, because corner shading is a function of that distance and nothing else: read as a column the seven are a trend, and a change that is the veil's can be told apart from a change that is the sky's.
